evaluation_mode: frozen runtime; query processing off; exact search

definitions.evidence_coverage_at_5: For all_of: completed evidence entries divided by required entries. For any_of: 1 if any acceptable alternative is completed, otherwise 0. Use saved entry_hits at cutoff 5. Average per answerable question.
definitions.required_evidence_count: all_of: number of gold entries; any_of: one alternative; unanswerable: zero.
definitions.recall_at_5: Located keyword coverage from saved evaluator; distinct from completed evidence-entry coverage.
definitions.zero_failure_counts: No confirmed assignment in this archive; absence of diagnostic evidence does not establish absence of the cause.

L1.configuration: Page-text PDF parsing; token windows up to 400 with overlap 40; normalized BGE-small dense embeddings; exact FAISS inner-product retrieval; no reranker.

L2.configuration: Page Markdown with selective local OCR; heading-aware chunks up to 400 and zero overlap; normalized BGE-base embeddings; exact pgvector dense 20 plus BM25 20; reciprocal-rank fusion with constant 60; no reranker.

L3.configuration: Docling with local OCR and table parsing; HybridChunker children up to 400 and same-heading parents up to 1500; BGE-M3 dense plus learned sparse; dense 20 and sparse 20 fused with constant 60; top 20 children scored by BGE reranker with sigmoid; at most five distinct parents. The existing snapshot includes cached captions.

limitations: One dataset, four neutral subjects, 37 documents, 200 questions: 184 answerable and 16 unanswerable. Quality averages exclude unanswerables. Answerable type samples have only 16–40 questions, with 4–10 per subject. This package evaluates saved retrieval, not generated answers or deployment performance. New coverage intervals and paired comparisons appear in the significance addendum; type-level findings use nominal, unadjusted thresholds. Several components change together, so these results cannot isolate a component’s causal contribution.

privacy_self_check.scope: All public files plus README; owner-approved question text checked separately.

method.rng: standard-library random.Random; seed reset for each estimate
method.sampling_unit: answerable question, sorted neutral ID; paired differences resampled together
method.interval: percentile bootstrap, linear interpolation at (B-1)*p; two-sided 95%
method.hit_interval: Wilson score, z=NormalDist inverse CDF at 0.975
method.hit_test: Exact two-sided McNemar: doubled smaller Binomial(discordant,0.5) tail, capped at 1; no mid-p correction
method.significance: Hit: p < 0.05. Coverage: paired 95% interval excludes zero. Nominal, unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
method.small_sample: Fewer than 20 answerable questions; groups with no eligible questions are N/A, not zero
method.missing_data: Unanswerable questions excluded; every comparison uses identical eligible neutral IDs
method.inference_limit: Question resampling on one fixed dataset; no subject/document cluster adjustment; no causal component attribution

question_publication.terminology_exception: Owner-requested terminology is permitted only in the approved question text; subject/document/ID metadata remain neutral.
question_publication.overlap_policy: Question text was explicitly approved by the owner. Its source/gold wording overlaps are reported separately from unexpected matches in result artifacts.

approved_question_privacy_check.scope: All public files plus README; owner-approved question text checked separately.
